title: Good rhythm sections and their players
summary: Williams names rhythm sections of Henry Martin, Buddy Petit, and Ridgely, and the reading players in the musical bands.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Yeah, like the square dance. Yeah, like the square dance. What about the good rhythm sections that they had back in those times? That's how- Who were some of the good rhythm sections, you know, that you heard?
Well, Henry Martin. That you heard? Well, Henry Martin. He had Lorenzo Stahls, you know, with Laura and you know, see Lorenzo Stahls and Montulli on bass, you know.

And there's a fine rhythm section. And my buddy had a good rhythm section. Me and Guy A. Butler rap, and a little T-boy, you know, Gilmore, you know, the bass. He had a nice, nice, sometimes Simon, you see. He had a nice rhythm section. Well, the manuals band, you see, I never did hear their band. See, they always played down the Creole, like Ranzami, you know, halls like that.
Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.

See, I never heard their band. They'd tell me they had fine bands, you know. I know most of the musical bands, you know. See, Vic Gasper, Oak, you know, fellas like that, you know, Piku, Teal, you know. Always had good musicians they did, you know. See, good reading musicians, you know. You get it? But all the band like Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan, they were a little tongue band. Celestane had a nice musical band. It was Ridley's band, you know. They had a nice musical band. Nice rhythm section, a little Chani on drum. But they didn't have Chani, they had Henry Zeno, you see. And from Henry Zeno and his Trapania. From Simon Marrera, guitar. Sometime he had originally had Willie Bartell guitar too. For a good while he played guitar. Now he used to sing. Yeah, he used to sing with them. Good rhythm section.
So those were some of the outstanding men on the instruments. Those were some of the outstanding men on the guitar players, banjo players, bass, drums.
Yeah, yeah. Drums, yeah. Yeah, they were outstanding.
Any others you want to mention on guitar, banjo, drums or bass?

Yeah, Vic Gaspar. Yeah, Vic Gaspar. Albert Glenny. And Oak Gaspar. Yeah, Oak. I mean Oak. Yeah. Vic Gaspar. Oak, yeah. Oak, yeah. And Albert Glenny. I played with those, you know, see. For a little while. Who was in the band with Oak? What band was that band? It must have been with Magnum, I guess.
